title: Assistant Professor, Scientific Officer and More Posts
qualification: Master’s Degree in Physics, B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgical Engineering, B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical/Metallurgy, Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering + M.E./M.Tech in Civil Engineering (Geo Informatics / Geoinformatics and Surveying Technology)
salary: Scientist-B (Mechanical): Level-10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC || Scientific Officer (Non-Destructive): Level-08 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC || Superintending Archaeological Engineer: Level-11 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC || Assistant Professor, Civil Engineering (Survey): Academic Level-10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
age_limit: All Posts: Standard UPSC relaxations apply. Specific age limits are not detailed in the provided data. Age relaxation details: OBC: +3 years; SC/ST: +5 years; PwBD: +10 years (max age not exceed 56 years); PwBD+OBC: +13 years; PwBD+SC/ST: +15 years; Central Govt. employees: +5 years; Ex-Servicemen: +5 years.
